physicalEvidence.summary: The full May 2026 study deploys goal-conditioned RL on an actual UR5e with RealSenseD415 and FoundationPose object estimates. A scripted MPC policy collects about80k transitions; filtering leaves60k training samples. The hierarchical flow/HJB-regularized value method is tested in20 physical episodes, achieving50/60/75% success at3/5/10cm goal tolerances. Preliminary failures include mid-air stalls and cases requiring intervention; HJB regularization itself does not enforce safe contact, force or actuator limits. This is prior-Purdue apparatus, not proven new-USF equipment. The extensive OGBench results are separate simulation.
